comparison.objective: Water soil while keeping a sprung leaf aside and avoiding wet leaves.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual hold-aside and controlled pouring of discrete liquid proxies.
comparison.success_condition: Latest versions require at least 90 ml on soil, at most 10 ml on leaves, restored leaf and jug, release, and arm return.
comparison.reason: This tests pouring and obstacle displacement, not precision socket engagement, collar locking, or iterative dynamic tuning.
